claims.statement: EEG-BIDS defines interoperable raw-data and metadata conventions for EEG, including structured JSON and tabular metadata, creating a public schema against which data packages can be validated.

Open EEG tooling already performs many preprocessing and bad-data operations, suggesting an MVP can orchestrate established methods while differentiating on cross-site acceptance rules, provenance, and workflow integration.

Hypothesis: hardware distributors and CROs will bundle a neutral QA report because unusable recordings discovered after participant visits or database lock create costs that neither sponsor nor site wants to absorb.

contrary_evidence: BIDS validators and open-source EEG libraries already cover format and some data-quality checks, so a standalone upload checker is insufficient.
Many research labs tolerate custom pipelines and may have low budgets outside sponsored or regulated studies.

economics.acquisition_route: Publish a reproducible benchmark on public datasets, then secure one distributor or CRO integration rather than selling lab by lab
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 15 CRO/OEM contracts averaging 250000 PLN plus study usage could reach 4.5-5.5 million PLN ARR in years 6-8; at 25% EBITDA, 6x EBITDA, and 75% ownership, founder equity could exceed 5 million PLN
economics.founder_time: 15-22 hours weekly for a research-grade MVP, then 8-12 hours weekly if partners handle study operations; regulated clinical work is deferred
economics.gross_margin_basis: Automated batch signal processing can support 75-88% gross margin; compute, validation, and study-specific configuration are the main costs
economics.payback: Target under 12 months for a CRO partner; preventing a small number of unusable participant sessions can fund the licence
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 25-80 PLN per research recording, 15000-60000 PLN per study, or 80000-250000 PLN annual OEM/CRO licence
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every recording is checked, protocol templates recur across sites, and historical QA adjudications remain valuable

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented labelled artifact patterns, protocol-specific thresholds, device translators, and adjudicated QA outcomes improve each new study
fingerprint.customer: Neuroscience CROs, EEG device distributors, multi-site research teams, sponsors, and research platforms
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Bundled by EEG hardware distributors, CRO study platforms, and research data-capture vendors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Device-agnostic EEG ingestion, QA, BIDS conversion, and provenance SaaS/API sold per study and through OEM licences
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: CRO, sponsor, or device platform pays per recording/study and when an acceptance report is issued
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A recording or site batch must pass objective data and metadata acceptance before analysis or sponsor handoff

founder_fit: Exceptional neuroscience and data-science fit, with a productised QA workflow rather than clinical interpretation. Distribution through CROs and device channels limits social load. Begin in non-diagnostic research with public or synthetic data and no patient-care claims.
risks: A false pass can make a study believe unusable data are reliable; the tool must expose metrics and human approval.
Health and research data require rigorous contracts, security, and regional hosting.
Hardware vendors may resist a neutral layer that makes device quality comparable.

structure.commercial_archetype: Scientific data acceptance and provenance rail
structure.control_point: The pass, review, or fail report required before an EEG dataset is accepted downstream
structure.critical_dependency: Demonstrated predictive validity of QA metrics across devices and protocols plus lawful access to adjudicated outcomes

thesis: Build a device-agnostic automated acceptance and provenance layer for EEG studies: format conversion, metadata completeness, channel and montage checks, artifact summaries, protocol deviations, and a signed handoff report. EEG hardware distributors, neuroscience CROs, and research-platform vendors would embed it before data are accepted for analysis or sponsor delivery.
title: EEG Data QA Rail
uncertainties: The highest-value buyer may be a CRO, device vendor, sponsor, or core lab; their acceptance criteria differ.
Automated signal-quality metrics may not generalise across paradigms, ages, caps, and hardware.
Clinical-trial use could require validation and quality-system work beyond a part-time founder's initial capacity.
